common_failure.phase: Native focused matrix completed; asynchronous driver failure during process/resource teardown
common_failure.note: The 1040 route also recorded handled first-chance access violations on earlier attempts; exit zero alone is not a clean diagnostic result.

established_contract_errors.error: Depth clipping left disabled while the renderer disables depth-clamping support
established_contract_errors.fix: Explicit enable_depth_clip=true in scene and probe pipelines
established_contract_errors.proof: Strict baseline SDL_CreateGPUGraphicsPipeline assertion; debug baseline artifacts 12098863777 and 12099571395

established_contract_errors.error: Cycled D32 attachment inherited stencil LOAD from zero initialization
established_contract_errors.fix: Stencil load and store DONT_CARE on D32 attachments
established_contract_errors.proof: Strict renderer-feature-profile GPU test assertion during development

established_contract_errors.error: R32_UINT object IDs requested filtered-sampler texture usage on D3D12
established_contract_errors.fix: Readonly storage texture, matching compute resource counts and samplerless integer texelFetch; regenerated all SPIR-V/DXIL programs
established_contract_errors.proof: Strict D3D12 test rejected the original usage; Vulkan count test also rejects incompatible storage-image descriptor variants

lifecycle.fix: Drain private backend work before child release, and independently flush/wait the actual SDL renderer GPU device at all four renderer-reset sites, including after module disable has cleared the private backend.
lifecycle.limit: The matched-symbol dumps identify the copy-versus-swapchain teardown overlap; individual contributions of invalid pipeline/texture contracts and the lifetime race are not isolated by separate native A/B runs.

performance_changes: Toroidal source and geometry windows invalidate only entering XY strips instead of copying all cached levels
Remove redundant cell ordering when traversal already supplies canonical order
Conservative affine AABB transform reused for culling and picking

compiler_cache.fix: Use upstream _CDDA_USE_CCACHE=true, supported on both exact engine pins; reject residual PCH bypasses and retain effective stats
compiler_cache.status: Final small-edit rebuild verified on both pins

diagnostic_infrastructure: Real child exit, first-chance/second-chance dumps and bounded debug events
Final progress sampled after process exit; bootstrap OK is separate from benchmark success
Matching Host PDB retention and originating-runner postmortem analysis
Eight independent strict focused children per engine; any dump or failed exit rejects qualification
Exclusive frame phase accounting checked against raw wall time and exact native-step indices
Classic-locale float streaming without locale-sensitive std::to_string(float)
Exact-byte paired movement comparison with pinned UDP/weather and actual hardware checks
quality_erratum: Previous 0.12.7 report called 1280x800 the internal cap; this is the CPU Balanced cap. The unchanged GPU Balanced path caps at 1920x1080 (1761x1080 for a 1768x1084 viewport by source calculation). No cap was lowered in 0.12.8.

retained_stack_analysis.image_match: Dump PE timestamp and image size match the runner DLL; its full SHA256 and Microsoft-symbol stacks are retained.
retained_stack_analysis.interpretation: Queued asynchronous WARP copy execution overlapped destruction of swapchain resources. The exact copied resource was not identified from the reduced dumps.

target.scope: Full-size GPU first rendered frames after native steps, clear plus controlled rain

recovery_infrastructure.powershell_environment: Remove competing flags explicitly; restore absent/empty/populated caller values
